meta.purpose: Configuration for AI sub-agent task automation in Phase 2 (Opus 4.5 optimized)

opusOptimizations.promptStyle: concise - focus on WHAT, trust model for HOW

5.9.agentPrompt:
Implement inline annotations for Feature 5 (Annotations & Sticky Notes).

Goal: Allow users to highlight text and add comments.

Key features:
- Text selection triggers highlight with comment button
- Annotation modal for entering comments with color picker
- Highlighted text shows tooltip on hover, opens edit modal on click
- Storage via existing storage adapter (IndexedDB/chrome.storage.local)
- WCAG 2.2 AA: Keyboard accessible, ARIA labels, focus management

Integrate with:
- Existing Highlight Menu (add 'Annotate' button)
- Existing storage adapter interface (getByUrl, create, update, delete)
- Existing color system (yellow/blue/green/pink/purple)

Files: src/features/annotations/inline-annotations.js (new), src/features/highlightMenu/highlight-menu.js, src/content/content-simple.js

Follow existing patterns. Match sticky note CSS patterns.

5.10.agentPrompt:
Implement annotation sidebar panel for Feature 5.

Goal: Provide a sidebar to view and navigate all annotations on current page.

Key features:
- Toggle button in popup ("View Annotations")
- Sidebar slides from right, shows all annotations/sticky notes for current page
- Each item: type icon, excerpt, timestamp, color indicator
- Click item scrolls to annotation and highlights temporarily
- Real-time sync on storage changes
- WCAG 2.2 AA: Keyboard nav, ARIA labels, focus trap when open

Integrate with:
- popup.html/popup.js (add toggle button)
- Existing storage adapter
- Message passing (popup → content script)

Files: src/features/annotations/annotation-sidebar.js (new), src/popup/popup.html, src/popup/popup.js, src/content/content-simple.js

Follow existing modal/sidebar patterns.

5.11.agentPrompt:
Implement tags system for Feature 5 annotations.

Goal: Allow users to organize annotations with tags.

Key features:
- Tag input field in annotation/sticky note modals
- Autocomplete from existing tags
- Display tags as colored pills
- Click tag in sidebar to filter
- Persist tags in annotation objects and tag list in storage
- WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility

Integrate with:
- sticky-note.js, inline-annotations.js (add tags field)
- annotation-sidebar.js (display tags, filter by tag)
- storage-adapter.js (store tags array)

Files: src/features/annotations/tag-manager.js (new), plus integration into existing annotation files

Follow existing color system patterns.

5.12.agentPrompt:
Implement search for Feature 5 annotations.

Goal: Allow users to search across all annotations.

Key features:
- Search input in sidebar header
- Search content, tags, URL (case-insensitive, partial match)
- Real-time filtering with debounce
- Highlight matches in results
- Show URL for cross-page results
- WCAG 2.2 AA: Keyboard accessible, ARIA live region

Integrate with:
- annotation-sidebar.js (add search UI and logic)
- storage-adapter.js (may need searchAll method)

No external search libraries needed - simple string matching.

5.13.agentPrompt:
Implement filtering for Feature 5 sidebar.

Goal: Allow multi-criteria filtering of annotations.

Filter options:
- Page: Current page / All pages
- Tags: Multi-select
- Date: Today / This week / This month / All
- Color: By annotation color
- Type: Sticky notes / Inline annotations / All

Key features:
- Filter dropdown in sidebar header
- Filters combine with AND logic
- Show active filters as removable badges
- "Clear all" button
- WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility

Integrate with: annotation-sidebar.js

Persist filter state in sessionStorage.

5.14.agentPrompt:
Implement export for Feature 5 annotations.

Goal: Allow exporting annotations in multiple formats.

Formats:
- Markdown (.md) - structured with headers
- Plain Text (.txt) - simple list
- JSON (.json) - full data export
- CSV (.csv) - spreadsheet-compatible

Key features:
- Export button in sidebar header
- Format dropdown menu
- Export current filter/search results (or all if no filter)
- Use chrome.downloads API
- Success toast notification
- WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility

File naming: annotations-export-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmm.{ext}

Files: src/features/annotations/export-manager.js (new), integrate with annotation-sidebar.js

5.16.agentPrompt:
Implement settings for Feature 5 annotations.

Goal: Expose annotation preferences in settings UI.

Settings:
- Default color for new notes
- Default note size (Small/Medium/Large)
- Auto-save toggle
- Show annotation count badge toggle
- Sidebar auto-open on annotation click toggle

Key features:
- Settings section in Advanced Options
- Store in chrome.storage.local under 'annotations.settings'
- Apply settings immediately on new annotations
- WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility

Integrate with:
- popup.html/popup.js (settings UI)
- sticky-note.js, inline-annotations.js (use settings)

Follow existing settings patterns from OCR/Dictionary features.

5.17.agentPrompt:
Create unit tests for Feature 5 CRUD operations.

Goal: 80%+ coverage on annotation business logic.

Test modules:
- storage-adapter.js: CRUD operations for both adapters
- sticky-note.js: create, delete, save, resize, color change
- inline-annotations.js: create, delete, update
- tag-manager.js: get, save, filter
- export-manager.js: all export formats

Test patterns:
- Happy path, error handling, edge cases
- Mock chrome.storage.local and IndexedDB
- Follow existing patterns from tests/unit/dictionary.test.js

Files: tests/unit/annotations/*.test.js

5.18.agentPrompt:
Create E2E tests for Feature 5 user workflows.

Goal: Test critical user paths with Playwright.

Workflows to test:
1. Sticky note: create, edit, drag, resize, color change, persist on reload
2. Inline annotation: select text, annotate, hover tooltip, edit, delete
3. Sidebar: open, search, filter, export

Key requirements:
- Use data-testid selectors for stability
- Test isolation (clean state between tests)
- Follow existing E2E patterns from tests/e2e/ocr.spec.js

File: tests/e2e/annotations.spec.js

6.1-6.4.agentPrompt:
Implement translation API integration for Feature 6.

Goal: Provide translation via free and premium APIs.

APIs:
- PRIMARY: LibreTranslate (free, no API key) - https://libretranslate.com
- FALLBACK: Google Translate (user-provided API key)

Key features:
- translate(text, targetLang, sourceLang) function
- Language detection via /detect endpoint
- Response caching (7 days, max 100 entries, LRU eviction)
- Error handling with user-friendly messages
- 30+ language support

File: src/features/translation/translation-api.js (new)

Follow Feature Isolation Pattern. Use async/await.

6.5-6.9.agentPrompt:
Implement translation UI for Feature 6.

Goal: Provide UI for text and full-page translation.

Key features:
1. Translation modal: Original/Translated side-by-side, language selectors, TTS integration, copy button
2. Highlight Menu integration: Add "Translate" button
3. Full-page translation: Translate all text nodes, preserve HTML, revert button
4. Language selector: Searchable dropdown with flags, auto-detect option

Integrate with:
- translation-api.js for API calls
- Existing TTS controller for speech
- Existing Highlight Menu
- popup.html/popup.js for full-page translate button

Files: src/features/translation/translation-ui.js (new), src/features/translation/full-page-translate.js (new), plus integrations

WCAG 2.2 AA compliance required.
